fixes: Alerts: get notified when a container exits unexpectedly, turns unhealthy, crash-loops, or nears its memory limit, when a PM2 app errors or keeps restarting, when host CPU, memory, or disk stays high, when Docker is unreachable, or when an agent stops answering. Admins set rules and channels in Settings → Alerts.

Alert channels: Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, or any JSON webhook, with a Test button, optional @here / @channel mentions, and Resolved messages. Webhook URLs stay on the server and are never shown again after saving.
Alerts button in the header shows how many alerts are new. Open it to see what is active (new ones tagged New) and recent history.
Diagnose: one click explains why a container is unhealthy from its health check, exit code, restarts, memory, recent errors, sibling containers, and host disk. Read-only, so viewers can use it.

Timeline: what changed and who did it. Container starts, stops, crashes, and health changes are recorded (kept 14 days, EVENTS_RETENTION_DAYS) and shown in Diagnose and System status, together with restarts, redeploys, and env edits from the audit log.
New DockBeacon logo across the app, browser tab, and website. Tidier header with an account menu (theme, settings, logout), and a slim icon rail when the sidebar is collapsed.
Log toolbar actions are grouped into Actions and More menus.

Upgrades no longer take the site down: older packages stopped and disabled the service during apt/yum upgrade (502 behind nginx). The service now restarts on its own after upgrading. Coming from v0.6.4 or older, run sudo systemctl enable --now docker-log-viewer once if it is still down.
The Update badge opens the new Upgrade section on the website with copyable apt and yum commands. The installer keeps your env file without the dpkg prompt.
The package now pulls in acl, so PM2 log access is granted during install and upgrade instead of failing with "setfacl is required".

System button in the header opens a System status panel: host CPU (usage, cores, load), memory (total, used, free, swap), and disk (total, used, free for / and the Docker data disk when separate). Refreshes every 5 seconds while open and follows the selected server.
Settings → Servers: admins can add, edit, and remove hosts for every user (saved on the server). Operators can still keep hosts in their own browser.
This server no longer appears twice behind an HTTPS proxy or under a URL prefix such as /dockbeacon.
Container Inspect is for operators and admins only. Viewers no longer see the button, and the server refuses /inspect for them.
The header shows an "Update" badge when a newer DockBeacon release is out, with its notes and the upgrade command. Turn off with UPDATE_CHECK=false.
One-step installer (install.sh) for apt and dnf hosts: installs or upgrades, asks standalone or agent, writes the env file, starts the service, and prints the URL.
Container start, stop, and restart use the same confirmation box as PM2. Viewers still cannot run those actions.
PM2 status and actions work under the packaged systemd unit: pm2-grant-access now lifts NoNewPrivileges on PM2 hosts, and the helpers find node for nvm installs.
Optional BASE_PATH so DockBeacon can be served at /dockbeacon/ when another application already uses /.
PM2 logs on hosts that already run PM2, with a Docker / PM2 switch in Logs. Hosts without a daemon stay Docker-only.
Operators and admins can start, stop, or restart a PM2 app. Viewers cannot.
One control-plane login covers every agent that shares AUTH_SECRET. No second login when switching hosts.
Settings: operators can edit a saved host and test the connection. Viewers do not see Servers.
Docker 29 and newer: retry the Engine API at 1.44 when the daemon rejects the negotiated client version.
Product renamed to DockBeacon across UI, docs, systemd, and the packages site (package id remains docker-log-viewer).
Stacks redesign: project header, pill tabs, contextual actions, Edit-before-save, and backup-on-save.
Fix Env load failures from unreadable .env perms; clear stale Compose content on tab switch.
Preserve file ownership on save; fail loudly if backup cannot be written; accept comma-separated EXTRA_CONFIG_DIRS.
Settings as a full page; compact monitoring table; inspect env secrets masked by default.
Compose editor: client-side YAML lint (js-yaml + offline fallback) with live error bar.
Unsaved-changes confirmation when leaving Stacks, switching tabs/projects, or toggling Reveal secrets.
Diff before save masks secret env values until unlocked.
Image pull streams layer progress into an on-page terminal drawer.
New-logs pill shows missed count and jump-to-bottom hint during live streams.
UI polish as DockBeacon: fixed theme toggle (html+body, localStorage, sun/moon icon).
Settings modal sticky header/footer with ✕, Escape, and backdrop dismiss.
Primary / secondary / destructive button tokens; tooltips and ⌘K container search.
Clearer empty states; floating new-logs pill with missed-line count.
Move app version beside the brand title in the header
docs(site): feature v0.2.0 changelog and document version badge
Production hardening: non-root systemd user, LISTEN_ADDR, COOKIE_SECURE=auto, CSRF tokens, WS Origin checks, agent CORS fail-closed.
Audit log + GET /api/audit; login rate limit; inspect env secrets masked for viewers.
Optional OIDC SSO (OIDC_* env); AUTH_LOCAL=false for SSO-only.
GPG-signed apt/yum when GPG_PRIVATE_KEY is set in release CI.
App version visible in the UI header and on the login screen (API: /api/info, /api/me, /health, login).
Packages site: architecture, security, production deploy, inspect-then-run install, SHA256SUMS, and filled package lists.
Regex filter toggle (.*) for advanced log search, saved in prefs and share links.
Pretty / compact JSON highlighting in the log stream (brace-matched, skips Laravel timestamps).
Optional host groups in Settings — merge logs across servers in the same group.
Metric sparklines on container stats with a fixed 0–100% scale.
Full-window expand focuses on the filter bar and logs only (Esc / e).
Packages site: light/dark themes, user guide, and Cloudflare Web Analytics.
Packages site shows latest version badge and a What's new changelog (including v0.1.11 UI fixes).
Clearing or unchecking all containers resets header chips, title, live stream, and stats (no stale “N containers (merged)” labels).
View logs button stays readable on hover and when disabled (primary teal + white text).
Clearer fictional product demo screenshot on the packages landing page.
Added product demo screenshot slot to the packages site.
